verdict.pick: Makeup by Mario Master Mattes Eye Shadow Palette: The Neutrals
verdict.line: Buy this if you want a versatile, buttery‑smooth palette that works for everyday looks and special occasions. It blends well, stays crease‑free all day, and is praised by multiple editors. The catch is that it’s the only palette listed with a price, so budgeting may be tighter.
